reputationDeeds: Cracked a Militech black site from Night City

steps.note: Netrunners carry Interface Abilities and programs. Programs augment NET actions (Backdoor, Cloak, Control, Slide, Virus, Zap, Scanner).

steps.label: list loaded programs and their stats

steps.note: An Admin or authorized Netrunner builds an architecture first: +netrun/build <name> <floors> <floorDV>. Then jack in: +netrun/jack <name>. Check status: +netrun/status. Navigate floors with +netrun/action <ability>. Disconnect cleanly with +netrun/jack_out.

NET actions (all require being jacked in): backdoor — bypass floor; cloak — hide from ICE; slide — dodge ICE attacks; scanner — scout next floor; zap — damage ICE; virus — install data-destruction; control — take over a node.
ICE counters automatically each turn. Use +netrun/endturn to end your NET action phase. Architecture is persistent (KV-stored) between sessions.

Brain damage (errata p.204): damage taken from Black ICE goes directly to HP, bypasses worn and subdermal armor, and cannot cause a Critical Injury. It still triggers wound state and death save thresholds.
